description: Defines a template class for a lock-based multi-producer, single-consumer (MPSC) concurrent queue with blocking and non-blocking operations, using mutexes, condition variables, and ring buffers.

classes.name: concurrent_queue
classes.description: A lock-based multi-producer, single-consumer concurrent queue supporting blocking and non-blocking push/pop operations.

methods.name: try_push
methods.description: Attempts to push an element without blocking.

methods.name: push_blocking
methods.description: Pushes an element, blocking if necessary until space is available.

methods.name: try_pop
methods.description: Attempts to pop an element without blocking.

methods.name: try_pop_bulk
methods.description: Attempts to pop multiple elements in bulk.

methods.name: pop_blocking
methods.description: Pops an element, blocking if necessary until an element is available.

methods.name: pop_blocking (returning optional)
methods.description: Pops an element and returns it as an optional, blocking if necessary.

methods.name: call_on_pop_blocking
methods.description: Executes a function on an element popped in a blocking manner.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current size of the queue.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Returns the maximum capacity of the queue.

methods.name: create_consumer
methods.description: Creates a sequential consumer for the queue.
